info.description: Location-aware specials, events, and optional dismissible header announcements. Use the Restaurant dropdown to control and filter visibility.

schedule.description: Optional display text such as Weekdays, 4–6 PM

restaurantScope.description: Controls website visibility and provides dropdown filtering. Choose all for every restaurant; choose multiple only when Locations contains more than one restaurant.

locations.description: Only required when Restaurant is multiple. Otherwise the Restaurant dropdown controls visibility.

showInBanner.description: Show this item in the dismissible bar beneath the site header while active.

dismissalKey.description: Change this value when you want a previously dismissed banner to appear again.
